notes.title: Update 10/MAY/2022 22:00 (PST)
notes.content:
1. 「Box: Mental Potion」: Weight changed from 2 to 20.

2. You can get paper from area XIANBEI.

3. Characters who invest 「CON」 while attending 「Hunting Championship」 can increase damage when defeating wolves.

4. The level limit of 「scroll: inside castle」 and 「scroll: go to castle」 has been changed to level 40.

5. 「NPC: Stone / etc」 sells 「citizenship」. You can change your nationality in-game.

6. 「Experience Protective Stone」's price changed from 30,000 to 100,000.

7. The probability of obtaining items from 「Dungeon of Assassin」's monsters has been changed. In the upper floor, it is similar to the previous one, and it decreases as you go to the lower floor.

8. RTK points that can be acquired from 「rivalry of local barons」 are applied according to the number of castles acquired. Each player can earn up to 20000 RTK points. You can earn a minimum of 2000RTK points. (If you survive to the end)

9. You can increase the active time by killing monsters in 「Red cliff war」 and 「GuanDu war」.

notes.content:
1 [Dungeon of Assassin] has been renewed.
The rewards, obtainable items, and monster stats have been changed.

The conditions for acquiring rewards for participating in the war have been relaxed.
Participants can obtain higher [Military Merits] than in other wars when using [ⓧPotion in battleⓛ] and [ⓧPotion in battleⓜ].

ម៉ាស៊ីនមេរបស់ Retro Three Kingdoms : NEWYORK#1 នឹងត្រូវបានផ្អាកសម្រាប់ការថែទាំចាប់ពីថ្ងៃទី 19/APR/2022 ម៉ោង 22:00 (PST) ដល់ថ្ងៃទី 19/APR/2022 ម៉ោង 23:00 (PST)។

1. [ផែនទី: តំបន់ដាច់ស្រយាល《ចោរសមុទ្រពណ៌លឿង》] និង [ផែនទី: តំបន់ដាច់ស្រយាល《Yamatai》]: អ្នកអាចប្រើឃ្លាំង។

2. បន្សំមួយចំនួននៃ [សៀវភៅបទពិសោធន៍⑴] ត្រូវបានបន្ថែម។

3. [ក្រណាត់★] ដែលត្រូវបានបង់ទៅកន្លែងទីមួយក្នុងក្រុមនីមួយៗនៅក្នុង Guando Wars ត្រូវបានប្តូរទៅជា [ក្រណាត់ⓛ]។

4. បទពិសោធន៍របស់ YAMATAI និង Yellow Turban Rebellion ត្រូវបានកើនឡើងបន្តិច។

5. ធាតុនៅក្នុងសារពើភ័ណ្ឌអាចត្រូវបានផ្លាស់ទីទៅទំព័របន្ទាប់ឬមុន។

6. ពេលវេលាដំណើរការ AOS ត្រូវបានកាត់បន្ថយ 20% ។

notes.title: Released on April 12th
notes.content:
You can enjoy a large-scale siege by accurately determining the collision between players.

1. It will be released on April 12 at 16:00 Singapore time.

2. Make three brothers in the game.
In an emergency, you can summon your brother to your location.

3. Take part in a large-scale siege. The winner can get a lot of loot.

4. Choose 24 heroes and make a new history for you. We will keep a good record of your achievements.

5. Auto-combat is not supported. 

6. It is priced at $4.99 and has a 10% discount on launch. (It's not pay-to-win.)

7. Indonesian, Cambodian, and Mongolian languages are additionally supported.

8. Full screen and window screen can be adjusted within the game.
